messages:
ben: Quick heads-up: turned on 4-bit quant + spec-decoder for new-30b in canary, seeing weird  tail spikes around seq=1024-1536 :thinking:
anya: details? numbers?
ben: p50/p95 fine, p99 jumps 7->20ms for token step when kv cache compaction runs
kevin: can you paste the profiler output? maybe a kernel fallback
ben: ```
[profile] model=redwood-30b-q4 spec=false => p99_token=7ms
[profile] model=redwood-30b-q4 spec=true  => p99_token=20ms (seq 1200-1300)
[trace] gpu-kernel: matmul_fused_v2 -> fallback to generic_gemm at runtime
```
ciara: hmm kernel fallback during speculative fill could explain it
anya: did you try disabling compaction? `--kv-compact=false` for a run
ben: yes, with compact off p99 drops to ~8ms but cost increases ~1.8x
ciara: could be quantized weight layout + compaction triggering an unsupported tiling path
kevin: logs from runtime?
ben: ```
E 1700001123 runtime: op matmul_fused_v2 not compatible with q4-block-layout -> trigger generic_gemm
W 1700001123 scheduler: speculative_task delayed 6ms waiting for generic_gemm
```
anya: can we repro locally with CPU-only microbench? faster iteration
ciara: i pushed a tiny patch to log tile sizes when fallback occurs, ran it in canary
ben: patch log shows tile 64x128 for fused, but q4 conversion uses 32x128 fastpath -> mismatch
kevin: suspect kernel selector incorrectly rejects q4-fastpath when speculative kv injection alters stride
ciara: will try forcing kernel selector to consider both layouts
deploy-bot: Canary deploy started: canary-id=canary-2024-04-01-12
ben: if we force 32x128 it removes fallback but increases p50 by 1ms, p99 back to ~9ms
anya: tradeoff ok for now for correctness, but long term need selector fix
ciara: filing a follow-up patch to kernel selector and adding unit test for speculative-insert stride
ben: created ticket MLINF-1428 with logs and reproducer
kevin: add eval run for quality too, ensure no regression with q4 spec decode
ben: started a short run: `./run_onboard.sh --model redwood-30b-q4 --speculative true --replay 2000` :eyes:
anya: thanks, keep us posted, will join a quick sync in 20m
ben: copying repro steps into the ticket
ciara: :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Canary deploy successful: 2/3 nodes healthy
ben: will follow up after selector patch test
